'''Gabredor III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated between [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]], in [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]]. It had a [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] transfer center under the authority of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] master [[Greezim Trentacal]]. Trentacal kidnapped the children of the [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] of [[Cantras Gola]] to force the [[PowerOn Conglomerate]] to remain with the [[Pentastar Alignment|Alignment]]; in exchange, the Alignment agreed not to interfere with Karazak operations. The center was destroyed by the [[Red Moons]], who rescued the children and other slaves.
